verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single claimed-docs line saying Yapily categorises and analyses transaction data with merchant detection and spending insights. That is adjacent to cash-flow analysis but focused on spending, not income. Raw balance and transaction retrieval exists as underlying data. Missing for 10: recurring income-stream detection, payroll/salary detection, a documented income verification product, cash-flow signal outputs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
